## Case Studies: Real Outcomes

### SmileCenter Dentistry — 5x Patient Inquiries
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/case-studies/smile-center-dentistry
- **Challenge**: Fragmented web presence across Southern California dental locations with low organic visibility and no local content architecture.
- **Solution**: React/Vite rebuild, location-specific SEO page architecture, SEO copywriting cluster, GBP optimization, and structured data deployment.
- **Outcome**: 213K monthly search impressions; 5x increase in patient form completions and phone calls.

### American Livescan — 3x Online Bookings
- **URL**: https://www.gobiya.com/case-studies/american-livescan
- **Challenge**: Legacy .htm site with no clean-URL structure, poor local signals, and untapped booking volume.
- **Solution**: Full migration to clean URL architecture, GBP optimization, NAP citation cleanup, and on-page SEO.
- **Outcome**: Tripled online appointments and phone calls for a high-volume LA fingerprinting service.

## FAQ

### What makes Gobiya different from traditional SEO agencies?
Traditional agencies sell activities (blog posts per month, link packages). Gobiya sells outcomes. We recover lost traffic, scale pipeline, architect SEO copywriting systems, and make your brand discoverable in both traditional search and AI-generated answers.

### How quickly can a site recover from a Google penalty or Core Update drop?
Forensic audits take 2–3 weeks. Once recovery protocols are deployed, search engine crawling recovers in 30–60 days, with organic traffic restoration typically occurring at the next core update cycle.

### What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)?
GEO is the process of optimizing your digital footprint so that large language models like GPT-4, Gemini, and Claude understand and recommend your brand when users ask conversational search queries.

### What is the difference between SEO copywriting and traditional copywriting?
SEO copywriting satisfies both the search crawler and the human reader simultaneously. It involves keyword and intent research, semantic heading architecture, entity-rich body copy, on-page elements (title, meta, schema), and GEO-optimized structure — all written to rank, convert, and be cited by AI engines.

## Technical Framework

- **Crawl Efficiency**: Core Web Vitals optimized, semantic markup, full mobile parity, static asset delivery.
- **Structured Data**: JSON-LD schema representing ProfessionalService, LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQPage entity types.
- **GEO Compliance**: llms.txt at /llms.txt; llms-full.txt at /llms-full.txt; OKF bundle at /okf/index.md.
